metrics.scope_note: This figure counts HAS_DEVATA and nothing else. Measured reach of each deity-attribution predicate in this build: HAS_DEVATA reaches RV (attribution resolved to a deity in the registry, as the source states it); HAS_DEVATA_DERIVED reaches AV (attribution resolved from an Anukramani descriptor by morphology, so the resolution is this project's and the dedication is the source's); HAS_DEVATA_ASCRIPTION reaches AV (the raw Anukramani descriptor, never resolved to a registry deity and never counted as an attribution to a named god). A Veda absent from a predicate's reach carries no edge of THAT predicate. It is not a statement that the deity is absent from the corpus, and it is not a statement that the corpus has no traditional index -- a dedication can be recorded by one predicate and unreachable by another, which is why each is named separately above.
